summary: Tableau Creator seat purchase + SCIM/Okta provisioning and billing center mapping
description: Issue summary: Data Insights requests purchase of 12 Tableau Creator licenses and onboarding to our Okta SCIM provisioning flow. Impact: Team needs Creator seats to maintain dashboard authoring cadence for Q2 product analytics and to complete scheduled migrations off legacy workbooks. Without seats, delivery of two analytics projects will be delayed ~3 weeks. Background: We currently have 5 legacy perpetual Creator licenses tied to user emails that are not SCIM-managed; these were purchased under an old contract. Request: (1) Procure 12 new Tableau Creator seats on an annual subscription tied to Redwood's corporate billing; (2) Enable SCIM provisioning and group sync via Okta so seat lifecycle is automated; (3) Map billing to cost center ENG-PLATFORM-23 and provide PO/invoice to Finance; (4) Decommission legacy perpetual licenses or reassign them as spare seats after vendor reconciliation. Regulatory/security note: Tableau instance will be on Tableau Cloud with SSO required; security review checklist requested prior to seat activation.
steps_to_complete: Confirm pricing and licensing model with Tableau sales rep (term: 12 months, Creator subscription)
Obtain vendor quote and formal SOW and attach to procurement ticket
Finance: approve cost center mapping ENG-PLATFORM-23 and generate PO
Okta: enable SCIM provisioning for Tableau Cloud, configure group mapping for Data Insights
Security: complete vendor security questionnaire and document any required controls
Procurement: finalize purchase, obtain invoice, and upload to SAP/Concur
Platform: validate that new seats are visible in Tableau admin and test SCIM user provisioning/deprovisioning
Reconcile legacy perpetual licenses with vendor and request transfer/reassignment or cancellation
